business_summary: China Merchants Expressway Network & Technology Holdings Co.,Ltd. operates as a highway investment and operation service provider in the People's Republic of China. It operates through Investment Operation, Transportation Technology, Smart Transportation, and Traffic Ecology segments. The company also offers full-process consulting and engineering technical services; and general contracting of engineering, design and construction, and project management services. In addition, it engages in technical service development; traffic information services; intelligent transportation product design; technology research and development; software development and computer network system engineering; technology transfer; business management; engineering consulting management; fund management; photovoltaic power generation; agricultural planting; highway engineering; scientific research and design; engineering supervision; production and installation; development and management of construction facilities; hotels; pipeline corridor leasing; ecological and environmental protection technology-related activities; highway engineering inspection; highway information technology development; water transport project supervision; and other technology promotion services. The company was formerly known as China Merchants Huajian Highway Investment Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to China Merchants Expressway Network & Technology Holdings Co.,Ltd. in September 2016. The company was founded in 1993 and is based in Beijing, the People's Republic of China. China Merchants Expressway Network & Technology Holdings Co.,Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of China Merchants Group Limited.
